intended_purpose: A continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system intended to measure interstitial glucose levels in adults and children with diabetes mellitus, providing real-time glucose readings and trend alerts to support diabetes self-management.
device_description: Subcutaneous wearable glucose sensor (14-day wear, factory-calibrated) paired with a disposable applicator and a companion mobile app receiver. Measures interstitial fluid glucose via an enzymatic (glucose oxidase) electrochemical sensor, transmitting readings via Bluetooth Low Energy every 5 minutes.
clinical_data_summary: Pivotal accuracy study (n=340, 14-day wear, home-use and clinic conditions): overall Mean Absolute Relative Difference (MARD) of 8.7% against YSI reference; consensus error grid analysis showed 99.1% of paired points in Zones A+B.
risk_summary: Risk management file per ISO 14971 identifies 28 hazards across sensor accuracy, skin irritation, wireless connectivity, and use-related categories. All residual risks rated acceptable after mitigation.
